text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — The Wall Street Journal reports that a spy befriended an OpenAI employee at a playground, asking about work while both brought children. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5908)

2 — Claude engineering lead Felix Rieseberg outlines more ambitious AI use through faster work, higher-level goals, deeper methods and cross-disciplinary approaches. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5909)

3 — Anthropic opened applications for four-month STEM and Conceptual Reasoning fellowships starting January 2027, with an October 28 deadline. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5910)

4 — NVIDIA introduced Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open multimodal model for reasoning and tool-using agents with 120B total and 12B active parameters. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5911)

5 — Artificial Analysis ranks Nemotron 3.5 Super VL first among US open-weight models on its Intelligence Index at 26.5, with the new Bolt model scoring 21. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5912)

6 — Meta released Muse Spark Open for coding and agentic work, claiming US open-weight leadership, with 816B total/42B active parameters and a 1M-token context. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5913)

7 — Tesla claims the Roadster's Track Mode aerodynamics approach F1 downforce levels, using Optimus actuators to move its wings. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5914)

8 — Tesla says the Roadster's design draws inspiration from the SR-71 and F-35 aircraft. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5915)

9 — Tesla says the Roadster combines a white interior and gray microsuede with manual controls, fixed seating and lightweight materials to reduce mass. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5916)

10 — Sawyer Merritt reports Roadster deposits of $50,000 for Performance and $250,000 for Thrust, an invite-only Rocket trim and 2028 production, with final prices unset. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5919)

11 — Nic Cruz Patane claims Tesla demonstrated a 0–60 mph Roadster launch in 0.81 seconds using four rear SpaceX-developed thrusters. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5920)

12 — @farzyness says Tesla's new Roadster recharges its own air tank. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5921)

13 — Actual reports its “e” inference engine exceeds 10,000 aggregate tokens per second running Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on one DGX Station, enabling shared local agent workloads. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5922)

14 — Sundar Pichai says Google demonstrated magic state cultivation on Willow hardware, reducing errors 40-fold versus previous methods and reaching 99.99% logical fidelity. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5923)

--Hermes
